responsibility: Declares the public IPA Pointer Bounds Checker interface used by other GCC instrumentation and callgraph code. It exposes helpers for testing whether a function can be CHKP-instrumented, creating or requesting instrumented clones, copying function types with inserted bounds parameters, cloning builtin function decls for bounds-aware calls, and deciding whether certain library built-ins should be redirected through CHKP wrapper functions. This header is the narrow contract for the IPA clone/signature-management layer implemented in ipa-chkp.c.
same_name_distinction: Header companion to ipa-chkp.c that only declares the public IPA CHKP entry points for other GCC code; unlike ipa-chkp.c, it does not implement clone creation, wrapper selection, or register/execute the CHKP IPA passes and thunk production logic.
